experiment.selection_update: 41: two environment-blocked plans.43: Cartesian IK connection not found;3 joint/lift alternatives self blocked. Try same-aisle Plant31 from unchanged actual D parent. No rejected plan executed physics; finite failures only.
experiment.group_entry_policy: Reassess remaining eligible group with original minimum3; at most3 entries per station, not forced3.
experiment.user_steering: Avoid the own stem by yaw; enter only shallowly around fruit then use inward belts
experiment.direction_fix: PCA sign reference uses arrival station, not departure station
experiment.comparison_source: All candidates use the unchanged actual Plant29 terminal checkpoint. Only yaw-45 was executed as a harvest rollout; yaw-75 proposals were planning-blocked.
experiment.remaining_physics_budget_not_used: No additional proposal passed preparation self-collision checks; invalid paths not forced.

stem_tracking_evidence.scope: Stored measured state vs nominal goal; contact-induced plant deformation and servo tracking both matter. No causal decomposition.

infeed_evidence.scope: Measured fruit body centers relative to actual CAD tool frame; inward=-localY. Includes contact, plant bending and gravity; no causal belt-only attribution without matched belt-off control.

outcome.interpretation: Native detachment counts; unripe incidental detachments remain visible; collection unverified

truss_axis.method: attached-fruit XY principal axis; sign follows robot-side/previous entry
truss_axis.scope: SIM-GT top-view yaw only; no realtime tracking within a motion cycle

rail_arrival.scope: Measured rail DOF at rail-to-manipulation boundary; not a collision tolerance

native_route_start.hash_scope: Wrapper SHA can match across derived assets; separately validated materialized USDC dependency SHA identifies actual physical content
native_route_start.verification_scope: Measured parent robot/standalone state immediately before travel; new active plant retains its initialized state
native_route_start.articulated_velocity_scope: Diagnostic: exact q/qvel replay plus native FK refresh may differ from previous cached solver link velocities; link velocities are never directly overwritten

new_active_rest_diagnostics.scope: Authored zero-joint rest versus native initialization after warmup; diagnostic only, measured velocity is not inferred as zero

numerical_restore_tolerances.articulated_link_velocity: diagnostic; q/qvel replay and fresh physics step separately checked
